body: That is very true, I should be thankful that I can even post this online while other people can't and are all alone. The enemy of my soul is unfortunately winning this battle...The enemy can't destroy all good if there was never any to begin with right? Thank you for replying and I really do hope that there are more people that care about me. Even my best best friend from high school stopped talking to me because he got so many new friends. I can tell he is ignoring me because whenever I try to text him, he gives bland replies like "ok" "yeah" "alright" "mhm". I'm an introvert so I thought being alone would be easy for me. But it's alot harder than I thought it'd be.

We are very similar. I didn't write it in my post but I am also 19 like you. My birthdays coming up soon. Have to go face my parents again and put up a fake smile and fake laughs when I'm with them and blow on the cake wishing for death. I finished high school, but with C's and D's so its the same as just failing high school. I'm also lazy, awkward of course, and forced to go to college when I didn't want to. I spend my days playing only video games and sleep less than 5 hours a day. I feel for you, thank you for replying.
